warnings: Axes: x = 1 / 1' / 2 / 3 / 4 at 0.20 + 2.50 + 3.50 + 4.00 (10.20); y = A-G at 3.50 + 0.50 + 2.00 + 0.50 + 1.50 + 1.50 (9.50). Origin A1. Vector CAD PDF, every value read off the rendered page.

Grid 1' is printed in its own bubble (0.20 right of grid 1) on S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04 and the elevations, so it is a named line, not a dummy. The column/footing at row F sits on grid 1; those at rows A and C sit on 1' (measured on S-01 and S-02, both agree).

Below G two different depths are printed: 1.00 on S-02 (structure plan) and 1.10 on S-01, S-03, S-04 and both side elevations. They are two different edges, not a conflict: on S-02 the south terrace beam B2 is drawn with its centre line at 1.00 and its outer face at 1.10; the S-03 roof slab RS1 runs to 1.10. Kept both lines, G' (10.50) and G'' (10.60).

Dummy naming: x 1'' (1.70) takes the prime after the PRINTED named line 1' (the grid to its left), so it reads as 1'' — check_format notes it as out of order only because it sees no 1' dummy; a printed name is never renamed (section 4), so this is deliberate; y A' (-1.00, before origin) and A'' (2.40) are one prime sequence in reading order (section 4).

Elevation z chain prints 0.55 between the two อะเส levels whose labels are +3.60 and +4.16 (difference 0.56); 0.46 + 3.14 + 0.55 + 0.68 = 4.83 matches the total and the +4.83 ridge label, so the 0.01 sits in the +4.16 label. Both kept as printed.

Truss elevations T1-T4 (S-03, S-05) print panel chains (1.000 / 1.167) and support sub-totals with no grid marker on them, so they stay on the truss elements (section files), not as grid chains. Their support sub-totals match the grid gaps (T3: 4.00/2.00/3.50 = A-C-D-G on grid 3; T4: 3.50/3.00/3.00 = A-B-E-G on grid 4).

Dimension sweep covers S-01..S-07 plus the four elevations A-05/A-06 (for levels and the reprinted grid chains). Other architectural/MEP sheets (A-03 floor plan, A-04 roof plan, A-09, A-10, E-01, SN-01, SN-02) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run.
